_comment: Shipped transmission lexicon (Kashshaf Lab spec §4.2). Entries are normalized surfaces (no tashkil, hamza on alif folded to bare alif as the engine's normalize_arabic does); multi-token entries are matched as token sequences; a leading و/ف proclitic on the first token is tolerated at match time. Groups can be toggled; the 'sama' group is the linking verb of a samāʿ chain (سمعت فلانا يقول سمعت فلانا يقول), which is how ṭabaqāt and Sufi biography carry their isnāds and which the ḥadīth-shaped core group does not reach; the 'citation' group opens a single-link citation rather than an isnād. User edits live in analysis.db (lexicon_entry); this file is the default and is re-synced on start without touching user rows or user-disabled rows.
